blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—National University got back to its winning ways after trouncing Adamson, 85-66, in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Mall of Asia Arena on Wednesday. Following a tough loss to Ateneo on Saturday, the Bulldogs dominated the Soaring Falcons to improve to a 3-2 record. “It’s a good response but we still had a subpar performance. We gave too much three-pointers. We need to address that,” NU coach Jeff Napa said.
